why: B's compact black-brown desk is modern and sober and fits well in front of the window. Its small bentwood armchair has a dark frame that matches the desk and fits the reading corner, and the set reads as one look. A's desk is a traditional piece with brass knobs, its 91 cm cognac armchair is bulky for this small room, and its pieces mix styles. Both share the off-palette light-wood bookcase top and tan leather.
